_note: Curated reference table for L7 commentary. Commentary may cite ONLY entries here. Bibliographic fields checked by hand (Claude, 2026-10-29); 'attribution' marks traditional attributions.

references.author: Roger Fisher; William Ury
references.title: Getting to Yes: Negotiating Agreement Without Giving In
references.idea_en: Focus on interests, not positions; invent options for mutual gain.
references.idea_ko: 입장이 아니라 이해(관심사)에 집중하고, 서로 이득이 되는 선택지를 만든다.

references.author: Roger Fisher; William Ury
references.title: Getting to Yes: Negotiating Agreement Without Giving In
references.idea_en: Know your BATNA: a walk-away threat only works if the alternative is real.
references.idea_ko: BATNA(협상 결렬 시 최선의 대안)를 알아야 한다. 결렬 위협은 대안이 있을 때만 힘이 있다.

references.author: H. P. Grice
references.title: Logic and Conversation
references.venue: In P. Cole & J. L. Morgan (eds.), Syntax and Semantics, Vol. 3: Speech Acts. Academic Press
references.idea_en: Cooperative principle: say as much as needed, truthfully, relevantly and clearly.
references.idea_ko: 협력의 원리: 필요한 만큼, 참되게, 관련 있게, 명료하게 말하라(양·질·관계·태도의 격률).

references.author: Thomas C. Schelling
references.title: The Strategy of Conflict
references.idea_en: Focal points: a salient split (like even shares) lets both sides converge without much talk.
references.idea_ko: 초점(focal point): 눈에 띄는 분할안(예: 똑같이 나누기)은 긴 말 없이도 양쪽을 한 점으로 모은다.

references.author: Thomas C. Schelling
references.title: The Strategy of Conflict
references.idea_en: Commitment: binding yourself to a position can win, but leaves no room to retreat.
references.idea_ko: 공약(commitment): 스스로 퇴로를 끊으면 이길 수도 있지만 물러설 자리가 없어진다.

references.author: Sunzi (孫子)
references.title: The Art of War (孫子兵法)
references.idea_en: Know the other and know yourself, and a hundred battles hold no danger (知彼知己 百戰不殆).
references.idea_ko: 지피지기 백전불태(知彼知己 百戰不殆): 상대를 알고 나를 알면 위태롭지 않다.

references.author: Sunzi (孫子)
references.title: The Art of War (孫子兵法)
references.idea_en: The best victory is won without fighting (不戰而屈人之兵).
references.idea_ko: 싸우지 않고 이기는 것이 최선이다(不戰而屈人之兵).

references.author: Penelope Brown; Stephen C. Levinson
references.title: Politeness: Some Universals in Language Usage
references.idea_en: Face-threatening acts cost goodwill unless they are softened (redressed).
references.idea_ko: 체면 위협 행위(FTA)는 완화 장치 없이 하면 호의를 깎는다.

references.author: Penelope Brown; Stephen C. Levinson
references.title: Politeness: Some Universals in Language Usage
references.idea_en: Positive politeness: showing approval and common ground protects the other's face.
references.idea_ko: 적극적 공손: 인정과 공통점을 보여 주면 상대의 체면을 지켜 준다.

references.author: Erving Goffman
references.title: Interaction Ritual: Essays on Face-to-Face Behavior
references.idea_en: Face-work: people act to keep their own and the other's face intact.
references.idea_ko: 체면 작업(face-work): 사람은 자신과 상대의 체면을 지키는 쪽으로 움직인다.

references.author: J. L. Austin
references.title: How to Do Things with Words
references.idea_en: Uptake: an act is only complete when the hearer takes it the way it was meant.
references.idea_ko: uptake: 말의 행위는 듣는 이가 그 뜻대로 받아들일 때 비로소 완성된다.

references.author: Howard Raiffa
references.title: The Art and Science of Negotiation
references.venue: Belknap Press of Harvard University Press
references.idea_en: Reservation prices define the zone where a deal is possible.
references.idea_ko: 양쪽의 유보 가격이 거래 가능한 구간(합의 영역)을 정한다.

references.author: David A. Lax; James K. Sebenius
references.title: The Manager as Negotiator: Bargaining for Cooperation and Competitive Gain
references.idea_en: Negotiator's dilemma: sharing information creates value but exposes you to value claiming.
references.idea_ko: 협상가의 딜레마: 정보를 나누면 가치가 커지지만 그만큼 빼앗기기도 쉽다.

references.author: Robert B. Cialdini
references.title: Influence: The Psychology of Persuasion
references.idea_en: Reciprocal concessions: a concession invites a concession in return.
references.idea_ko: 상호 양보: 한 번 물러서면 상대도 물러설 의무감을 느낀다.

references.author: Alvin W. Gouldner
references.title: The Norm of Reciprocity: A Preliminary Statement
references.idea_en: The norm of reciprocity: people feel bound to return what they receive.
references.idea_ko: 호혜성 규범: 받은 만큼 돌려줘야 한다는 보편적 규범.

references.author: Amos Tversky; Daniel Kahneman
references.title: Judgment under Uncertainty: Heuristics and Biases
references.idea_en: Anchoring: the first number on the table pulls later estimates toward it.
references.idea_ko: 닻 내림 효과: 처음 나온 숫자가 이후 판단을 끌어당긴다.

references.author: Adam D. Galinsky; Thomas Mussweiler
references.title: First Offers as Anchors: The Role of Perspective-Taking and Negotiator Focus
references.venue: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 81(4), 657-669
references.idea_en: Making the first offer tends to anchor the final agreement in your favor.
references.idea_ko: 먼저 제안한 쪽이 최종 합의를 자기 쪽으로 끌어오는 경향이 있다.

references.author: Robert Axelrod
references.title: The Evolution of Cooperation
references.idea_en: Tit for tat: be nice first, answer defection, forgive quickly.
references.idea_ko: 맞대응(tit for tat): 먼저 협력하고, 배신엔 응수하고, 빨리 용서하라.

references.author: Emanuel A. Schegloff; Gail Jefferson; Harvey Sacks
references.title: The Preference for Self-Correction in the Organization of Repair in Conversation
references.idea_en: Repair: conversation prefers that trouble be fixed quickly, ideally by the speaker.
references.idea_ko: 수선(repair): 대화는 문제가 생기면 빨리, 가능하면 말한 사람이 바로잡는 쪽을 선호한다.

references.author: Harvey Sacks; Emanuel A. Schegloff; Gail Jefferson
references.title: A Simplest Systematics for the Organization of Turn-Taking for Conversation
references.idea_en: Each turn sets up what the next turn should do; a missing response is noticed.
references.idea_ko: 각 턴은 다음 턴이 할 일을 정해 둔다. 와야 할 응답이 빠지면 눈에 띈다.

references.author: Aristotle
references.title: Rhetoric
references.idea_en: Persuasion works through character (ethos), emotion (pathos) and reason (logos).
references.idea_ko: 설득은 인품(에토스), 감정(파토스), 논리(로고스)로 이뤄진다.

references.author: William Ury
references.title: Getting Past No: Negotiating with Difficult People
references.idea_en: Go to the balcony: do not react to pressure in kind; step back and reframe.
references.idea_ko: 발코니로 가라: 압박에 같은 방식으로 맞받지 말고 한발 물러서 판을 다시 짜라.

references.author: Traditional; attributed to Wang Jixin (王積薪)
references.title: Ten Precepts of Go (圍棋十訣)
references.idea_en: Do not be greedy for the win (不得貪勝).
references.idea_ko: 부득탐승(不得貪勝): 이기려고 욕심내면 그르친다.

references.author: Traditional; attributed to Wang Jixin (王積薪)
references.title: Ten Precepts of Go (圍棋十訣)
references.idea_en: Give up stones to take the initiative (棄子爭先).
references.idea_ko: 기자쟁선(棄子爭先): 돌 몇 점을 버리고 선수를 잡는다.

references.author: Traditional; attributed to Wang Jixin (王積薪)
references.title: Ten Precepts of Go (圍棋十訣)
references.idea_en: Enter the opponent's sphere slowly (入界宜緩).
references.idea_ko: 입계의완(入界宜緩): 상대 영역에 들어갈 때는 천천히.

references.author: Traditional; attributed to Wang Jixin (王積薪)
references.title: Ten Precepts of Go (圍棋十訣)
references.idea_en: When your position is isolated, seek peace (勢孤取和).
references.idea_ko: 세고취화(勢孤取和): 형세가 외로우면 화평을 취하라.

datasets.author: Kushal Chawla; Jaysa Ramirez; Rene Clever; Gale Lucas; Jonathan May; Jonathan Gratch
datasets.title: CaSiNo: A Corpus of Campsite Negotiation Dialogues for Automatic Negotiation Systems
